FINAL ANSWER: <your answer>

The original critical path runs through Marketing assets → Data backfill → Go-live, finishing Thu 1/7.

## Applying the changes

- **Task 13 (Data backfill)** grows from 2 to 4 working days. It starts Tue 1/5 (after Marketing assets ends Mon 1/4) and runs Tue 1/5, Wed 1/6, Thu 1/7, Fri 1/8. It now finishes Fri 1/8.
- **Task 11 (Bug-fix sprint)** grows from 3 to 7 working days. It starts Wed 12/16 and runs 12/16, 12/17, 12/18, 12/21, 12/22, 12/23, 12/24 (12/25 is a holiday), finishing Thu 12/24. That is still well before the other go-live predecessors, so it does not drive the finish.

## Go-live

Go-live depends on:
- Data backfill, finishing Fri 1/8
- Support training, finishing Thu 12/24
- Bug-fix sprint, finishing Thu 12/24

The latest predecessor is Data backfill on Fri 1/8. Go-live is 1 working day, so it starts Mon 1/11 (the next working day) and finishes that day. Mon 1/11/27 is a Monday, as required.

The project now finishes on Mon Jan 11.

FINAL ANSWER: Mon Jan 11
